base_prompt: Turkish alternative pop, intimate live studio band, instrumental only. Warm acoustic guitar, expressive piano, melodic electric bass, real drum kit, restrained clean electric guitar. Cohesive memorable recurring two-bar lead motif, human microtiming and touch, breathing room for a future singer. No EDM drop, no genre switch, no dense synth layers, no vocals or speech. Key B minor, 102 BPM, 4/4. Lead motif: Two-bar melodic hook over Bm to Gmaj7 in 4/4 time at 102 BPM on the lyric 'Beyaz teğel ipi çektim söküldü'. Bar 1 opens directly on beat 1 with scale degree 1 (B3) for 'Be-', leaps up to degree 3 (D4) on beat 1-and for '-yaz', sustains degree 4 (E4) across beat 2 on 'te-ğel', then ascends cleanly to degree 5 (F#4) on beat 3 on 'i-pi', settling back to degree 3 (D4) on beat 4. Bar 2 delivers melodic resolution: degree 4 (E4) on beat 1, stepping down to degree 2 (C#4) on beat 2 on 'çek-tim', and landing on tonic degree 1 (B3) across beats 3 and 4 on 'sö-kül-dü' with open, unforced resonance..

timeline.name: intro
timeline.arrangement: Sparse upright piano arpeggios layered with delicate fingerpicked acoustic guitar in drop-D tuning, leaving deliberate breath and silence between chords.

timeline.name: verse_1
timeline.arrangement: Upright piano root notes sustained quietly under muted acoustic guitar eighth notes. Soft kick drum on beats 1 and 3, dry wooden rim clicks on 2 and 4, anchored by a warm, round electric bass.

timeline.name: pre_1
timeline.arrangement: Drums enter with soft eighth-note closed hi-hats. Bass walks up stepwise through inversions while a warm analog synth pad gradually swells under the acoustic guitar.

timeline.name: chorus_1
timeline.arrangement: Full rhythm section enters: open acoustic strumming, dry vintage snare, melodic bass following the kick pattern, and a clean electric guitar line with light tape chorus doubling the hook contour.

timeline.name: turnaround
timeline.arrangement: Drums pull back to rim click and kick. Electric guitar restates the core two-bar melodic motif over sustained piano and melodic bass fills.

timeline.name: verse_2
timeline.arrangement: Kick, rim click, and active bass re-enter immediately to maintain story tempo, supported by dry muted electric guitar chops accentuating the off-beats.

timeline.name: pre_2
timeline.arrangement: Snare shifts from rim click to ghosted center hits; floor tom pulses on beats 2 and 4, while doubled acoustic guitars lead an ascending harmonic build.

timeline.name: chorus_2
timeline.arrangement: Full organic groove returns with wider stereo acoustic guitars, active melodic bass counterpoint, and high-register guitar fills answering vocal cadences.

timeline.name: bridge
timeline.arrangement: Sudden drop in instrumentation shifting to a Neapolitan Cmaj7 color; drums strip down to subtle ride cymbal washes and felt mallets, framing close-mic vocal intimacy.

timeline.name: final_chorus
timeline.arrangement: Dynamic peak with thick acoustic strumming, punchy live kit, driving bass lines, ambient guitar swells, and tight doubled vocal unison on the central hook line.
timeline.chords: Bm - Gmaj7 - D - A - Bm - Gmaj7 - Em7 - F#7

timeline.name: outro
timeline.arrangement: Rhythm section recedes into natural room reverb decay. Upright piano and fingerpicked guitar resolve slowly over a sustained low B pedal tone, fading on a suspended Bmadd9.
